remarks: Charming, updated modern colonial in a desirable, walk-to-town neighborhood. Enjoy a gracious open floor plan with sunlit rooms, hardwood floors, and great flow for entertaining. Perfect for family and friend get-togethers. The well-appointed kitchen offers quartz counter tops, a center island, stainless appliances, and easy access to the main living spaces. Enjoy nearly one-floor living with the spacious primary bedroom, bath, and walk-in closet on the same floor as the living room and washer and dryer room. Walk up three stairs to find the cozy fireplace room and kitchen with great room. On the second floor, find three bedrooms and a bathroom. Walk down to the ground floor to find more living space in the large, fully finished heated and air conditioned walk-out basement with a full bath and a private entrance that leads to a patio with a gas grill connection and the tennis/pickleball court. Outdoor spaces offer decks and patios galore, perfect for watching the pickleball match or reclining surrounded by mature trees and plantings.  Available January 1st 2025. Lease terms are negotiable. Property showings start November 1st.  Tenant responsible for cable TV, credit check, electricity, ground maintenance, hot water, gas, insurance, snow removal, trash service, and water.
